title: [3.0.0.1-dev] unbelievable values when adjusting the ISF.
body:
Since April 1st, I have been using the "DEV - DynISF".
Since yesterday it comes to unbelievable values when adjusting the ISF. See logs
I have uninstalled the program, restarted the phone and reinstalled the program. But this did not change the ISF values.
Maybe it is just a graphical error.
The values rose above 10000 in the display.
